purpose: Replay the predeclared fixed-map seed 74803 baseline episode with the relief-v2 dual-view renderer; no training, policy selection, physics or task change.

representative_video.selection_rule: same predeclared seed 74803 as the archived dual-view-v1 video; visual comparison only, no best-looking rollout selection

claim_boundary: The replay may establish visual equivalence and improved topographic legibility only. It cannot create new locomotion, navigation, safety or optimality evidence.
